nodes.asset_description: Central illustration panel: upper half shows a pink checkerboard made of soft-edged squares; lower half has diagonal sunburst rays alternating warm peach and pink. Centered is a watercolor coupe glass with a thin stem and foot, filled with a semi-frozen pink strawberry daiquiri with bubbles and highlights. A ripe strawberry with seeds and green calyx is perched on the rim at the upper left of the glass. Subtle glass reflections and a soft drop shadow are present.

nodes.svg_description: Thin black rectangular frame with an inner horizontal divider creating a top information band and a larger bottom section. The bottom section is split into two equal columns by a centered vertical divider. In the top band, two short horizontal rules sit left and right of a centered row of five small color swatches (rectangles) from left to right: #f7d1c3, #f7b2c0, #f38aa3, #e66a84, #b21f3e. Strokes are #1f1f1f, about 2px; corners are square; fill is transparent.

nodes.text: The Daiquiri, the classic cocktail from which the Strawberry Daiquiri is derived, was invented in the early 20th century in Cuba by American engineer Jennings Cox. It was named after Daiquiri beach near Santiago de Cuba. The original Daiquiri was a simple mix of rum, lime, and sugar.
2 oz White Rum | 1 oz Fresh Lime Juice | 1/2 oz Simple Syrup | 1/2 cup Fresh Strawberries | 1 cup Crushed Ice
